sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-GGUF: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-GGUF is a 27-billion-parameter dense language model with integrated vision, thinking, and tool-use capabilities, maintained by froggeric. The model features Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) self-speculative decoding built directly into its architecture, delivering 2.5x faster text generation compared to standard inference.
